description: This file defines interfaces for blocking closure mechanisms used in inter-process communication within the Rialto project. It includes factory methods for creating blocking closures with different behaviors (polling and semaphore-based) and declares the IBlockingClosure class with a wait() method.

classes.name: IBlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating different types of IBlockingClosure objects, including polling and semaphore-based closures.

classes.name: IBlockingClosure
classes.description: Interface representing a blocking closure with a wait() method to wait for completion.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of IBlockingClosureFactory.

methods.name: createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a polling IBlockingClosure object that pumps the event loop during wait.

methods.name: createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a semaphore-based IBlockingClosure object that does not pump the event loop during wait.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the response is received.
